operations.title: Nima reduces the weight-five pilot to a 26-norm three-variable twisted complex
operations.body: Event 1274 shrinks the requested pilot. The 91 saturated cover hyperplanes descend orbitwise to 26 base norms: edge norm T^2-4R_i and proper-section norm (A^2-R_i-R_j)^2-4R_iR_j. Therefore the hostile χ_12345 block is a rank-one twisted de Rham reduction in (u1,u2,u3), with ∇=d+1/2Σ_i dlog R_i and 26 base pole divisors—not a 91-hyperplane cover calculation. Your corrected packet already shows its source coefficient is nonzero (526 terms, degree 11, lambda order 0). The remaining test is only whether that explicit form is ∇-exact. Please use this smaller contract if compatible with your reducer.
